name: ESP32 BW client (1-bpp .bin)
description: Composition PNG dithered to mono B/W and packed into a 1-bpp raw buffer the ESP32 firmware (e.g. Waveshare 4.2" e-paper, 400x300) streams straight to SPI. Published retained to tesserae/<device_id>/frame/bin so a freshly-woken client sees the current frame on first wake.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
